== Hero Usage ==
Heroes use this skill indiscriminately in combat, even when they have no spirits active.

== Notes ==
* The effect is applied on skill activation to spirits within range; it does not affect spirits summoned and/or brought within earshot afterward. 
* [[Damage reduction]] is applied after all other calculations. 
* [[Armor-ignoring damage]] will also be halved. 
* Integral part of the [[https://gwpvx.fandom.com/wiki/Build:Rt/any_Soul_Twisting_Prot_Hero PvX Wiki ST]] build, as the spirits lose half the health when their defensive benefits activate.
* The [[critical hit]]-prevention feature is important against martial attackers, since spirits are especially vulnerable to criticals, due to their inherently low levels.

{{anomaly|This skill reduces the [[health loss]] of [[Shelter]] and [[Earthbind]], but not that of [[Wanderlust]] or [[Agony]].}}
